faq.description: The short answers to the things people ask most.
faq.title: questions.

privacy.question: Do you read my emails?
privacy.answer: Rules run on your own mailbox via the Gmail API. We only look at subject lines, senders, and bodies when a condition requires it, and only for the length of the call. Nothing is stored on our servers.

processed.question: What counts as an "email processed"?
processed.answer: Any incoming email that matches an active rule and triggers an action. Emails that don't match a rule don't count against your monthly quota.

providers.question: Which email providers does Zer0Email support?
providers.answer: Gmail and Outlook (personal and Microsoft 365). You can connect multiple accounts across both providers and manage them from one dashboard.

rules.question: How does the rule engine work?
rules.answer: You define rules using conditions (sender, subject, body keywords, date) and actions (label, archive, forward, reply, delete). Rules run automatically the moment a matching email arrives. You can also describe a rule in plain English and let the AI assistant set it up.

cancel.question: Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time from billing settings. Your rules keep running until the end of the billing period.
